\section[(dialogue)]{Describing people and things — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R132-first-pass-describing-people-and-things}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for nice and friendly.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a yoghurt, a nurse, a cook, a police officer, a shop assistant
  \item a farmer, a baker, a driver, a lawyer, an engineer
  \item a postman, a waiter, a customer, a till, a boss
  \item a job, a class, an exam, a board, a rubber
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A yoghurt? (\textbf{der Joghurt}.) A nurse? (\textbf{die Krankenschwester}.) A cook? (\textbf{der Koch}.) A police officer? (\textbf{der Polizist}.) A shop assistant? (\textbf{der Verkäufer}.) A farmer? (\textbf{der Bauer}.) A baker? (\textbf{der Bäcker}.) A driver? (\textbf{der Fahrer}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{der Anwalt}.) An engineer? (\textbf{der Ingenieur}.) A postman? (\textbf{der Briefträger}.) A waiter? (\textbf{der Kellner}.) A customer? (\textbf{der Kunde}.) A till? (\textbf{die Kasse}.) A boss? (\textbf{der Chef}.) A job? (\textbf{der Beruf}.) A class? (\textbf{die Klasse}.) An exam? (\textbf{die Prüfung}.) A board? (\textbf{die Tafel}.) A rubber? (\textbf{der Radiergummi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{More describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R132-second-pass-more-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for homework and an idea.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item homework, an idea, a sentence, a page; a side, a drawing
  \item sport, a film, football, a concert, a celebration
  \item pink, orange, pretty, round, wide
  \item busy, free, closed, quiet, narrow; tight
  \item hard-working, lazy, awake, nice, friendly
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Homework? (\textbf{die Hausaufgabe}.) An idea? (\textbf{die Idee}.) A sentence? (\textbf{der Satz}.) A page; a side? (\textbf{die Seite}.) A drawing? (\textbf{die Zeichnung}.) Sport? (\textbf{der Sport}.) A film? (\textbf{der Film}.) Football? (\textbf{der Fußball}.) A concert? (\textbf{das Konzert}.) A celebration? (\textbf{das Fest}.) Pink? (\textbf{rosa}.) Orange? (\textbf{orange}.) Pretty? (\textbf{hübsch}.) Round? (\textbf{rund}.) Wide? (\textbf{breit}.) Busy? (\textbf{beschäftigt}.) Free? (\textbf{frei}.) Closed? (\textbf{geschlossen}.) Quiet? (\textbf{ruhig}.) Narrow; tight? (\textbf{eng}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{fleißig}.) Lazy? (\textbf{faul}.) Awake? (\textbf{wach}.) Nice? (\textbf{nett}.) Friendly? (\textbf{freundlich}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
